scenarios.name: Require actual upload acceptance
scenarios.given: an archive export succeeded without upload acceptance
scenarios.when: the TestFlight helper evaluates its result

scenarios.name: Do not upload the same build twice
scenarios.when: the helper is called again for that build
scenarios.then: the accepted receipt prevents another upload

scenarios.name: Reject unintended Watch distribution
scenarios.given: a phone-only beta upload is selected without the explicit Watch beta option
scenarios.when: its archive unexpectedly embeds a Watch app
scenarios.then: the helper refuses before upload and explains the explicit Watch beta option

scenarios.name: Identify the translation recovery beta and bundled changes accurately
scenarios.given: a user updates to the Watch-enabled translation recovery beta using standard or the largest accessibility text
scenarios.when: What’s New appears or is reopened
scenarios.then: the app identifies version 1.20.2 build 42 with its Recover stalled translations notes, acknowledges the update once, and keeps the oldest release heading and Continue usable at the largest text size

scenarios.name: Reach settings controls without dismissing the form
scenarios.given: a user has scrolled a long cloud AI settings form
scenarios.when: the test returns to the provider control and then the key and model controls
scenarios.then: Settings remains open, the visible controls can be used, and switching vendors clears the unsaved key without fetching models

scenarios.name: Validate an explicitly selected Watch beta
scenarios.given: a Watch-enabled beta is explicitly selected with a matching device-platform companion
scenarios.when: the helper checks the candidate in dry-run or upload mode
scenarios.then: dry-run never uploads, upload acceptance records requested and observed Watch inclusion with physical acceptance unverified, and missing or malformed companions and invalid options are refused before upload

scenarios.name: Keep Watch in the default companion installation configuration
scenarios.given: the repository is generated without any Watch opt-in environment variable or with the old switch disabled
scenarios.when: a fresh iPhone project is generated
scenarios.then: the app depends on the Watch target and copies its product into the Watch installation directory, keeping future app builds from silently dropping the companion

scenarios.name: Inspect Watch recording UI without capturing microphone audio
scenarios.given: the explicit simulator-only Watch preview is selected
scenarios.when: the user accepts recording consent, starts and stops the preview
scenarios.then: the real Recording indicator and Stop control render, Stop returns to Record, and release captures are preserved without microphone permission or live audio; an established preview recording survives an actual simulator app background/return

scenarios.name: Upload with explicit validated manual distribution signing
scenarios.given: a validated iPhone/Share archive, optionally including its Watch companion, and explicitly selected manual App Store upload options or the unchanged automatic default
scenarios.when: the release helper or make target is invoked with those options
scenarios.then: only the stable team, upload destination, App Store method, fixed versions, exact bundle/profile map and certificate selector reach Xcode; dry runs never upload, invalid options fail before Xcode, and actual acceptance retains source and signing provenance while duplicate/active uploads stay blocked; changing the original file after validation cannot change the private options snapshot used for upload

scenarios.name: Generate a distinct sandboxed Mac App Store distribution
scenarios.given: the Mac platform shares the existing iPhone App Store listing
scenarios.when: the native project is generated for App Store distribution
scenarios.then: the Mac AppStore configuration matches the listing bundle identifier, uses US English and declares sandbox access for microphone, outgoing model requests, Calendar and user-selected imports and exports; export preserves the version without implicitly uploading; export selects local distribution identities and the exact Mac profile without cloud-managed signing

scenarios.name: Preserve existing Mac installation identities
scenarios.given: a user already has the DMG or a Dev installation with its own permissions and data
scenarios.when: a Mac App Store distribution configuration is added
scenarios.then: the generated DMG and Dev configurations retain their original bundle identifiers and the DMG retains its existing entitlements

scenarios.name: Restore a Mac vault security scope
scenarios.given: a Mac user has chosen a folder for conversation Markdown notes
scenarios.when: its persisted bookmark is restored and a writer is recreated
scenarios.then: the bookmark restores a native security scope and the new writer saves a note in the chosen folder; existing legacy unsandboxed bookmarks remain usable where the OS permits access

manual.reason: A Core temporary-folder bookmark test cannot establish actual sandbox picker grants across app relaunch.
steps: In the sandboxed Mac app pick an external vault, save, quit/relaunch and save again. Verify deleted or revoked folders request reselection. Core temporary-folder scope checks are not a sandbox relaunch acceptance pass.

scenarios.name: Restore scoped Mac file and folder references
scenarios.given: a Mac user selects a text file and a reference folder
scenarios.when: the selection is saved and restored by a new persistence adapter
scenarios.then: both native security scopes and both reference contents are available; a corrupt saved grant is excluded with reselection guidance, and Clear removes saved paths and bookmarks; actual picker grants across sandbox app relaunch remain separate acceptance

manual.reason: Native temporary-folder scopes do not prove sandbox picker grants after a full application relaunch.
steps: In the sandboxed app pick an external file and external folder, quit/relaunch and verify both contents remain available.
Revoke or delete a reference and verify readable reselection guidance.
Cancel a read and clear references; verify no late context is applied and no grants remain in saved preferences.

scenarios.name: Run Mac sandbox acceptance with the existing Dev identity
scenarios.given: a maintainer needs to exercise the Mac sandbox locally before Store review, while the Store-signed package requires eligible distribution provisioning
scenarios.when: the SandboxAcceptance configuration is generated or its local build is requested without a signing override
scenarios.then: the local configuration keeps the Store file, audio, Calendar and network sandbox boundaries and release optimization under the existing Dev identity without a Store profile; an absent signing override stops before build or upload, and Store and DMG identities remain unchanged; an explicitly unsigned CI compile is not installed acceptance

manual.reason: Generated settings do not prove an installed sandbox app or production-distributed package runs.
steps: Build with the configured stable development identity; verify exact com.tomwu.ListenToMe.dev signature and actual App Sandbox entitlements before launching.
Exercise external reference/vault picker grants across relaunch and actual microphone/OTHERS capture; preserve native screenshots and signing/source provenance.
Keep Store/TestFlight installation acceptance separate. After the completed Dev session, perform only the authorized app-scoped cleanup.
